text:
Omar H.: Partner labs dayzero slate - need final checklist for the joint perf bench with PhaethonLabs. Metrics: perf/W, sustained throughput targets (target: ~2k toks/sec), and kernel patches that are fallback-only. Timeline: want lab run Wed 10:00 PT. Who's owning telemetry ingest + embargo/announce timing?
Jin Park: I can own telemetry ingest. What datasets and model versions are we locking to?
Omar H.: Lock to mpt-7b-quant (v3) and llama2-13B-q4a for parity. Dataset: redwood-microbench v2 (https://redwood.internal/datasets/redwood-microbench-v2). KV cache off for parity. Sweep batch sizes 1,8,32.
Lena Ortiz: For kernel patches - can we deliver them as fallback modules so partner doesn't need a full rebuild? Also we need signed CVE/impact check before any public numbers.
Evan G: Marketing note - partner is asking for co-announcement but will hold until benches are stable. Recommend 48h embargo after final run to allow validation and legal.
Jin Park: Telemetry plan: ingest token-level perf, power (watts) from lab PDUs, and kernel trace events. Will publish schema to #eng-ml and wire it to `telemetry-ingest` endpoint.
BenchBot: Lab reservation: phaethon-lab-3 reserved Wed 10:00-14:00 PT for `partner_bench_dayzero`. Tag @BenchBot to request extension.
Omar H.: Action items: Jin -> telemetry schema + ingestion path; Lena -> fallback kernel patch + compatibility doc + CVE check; Evan -> draft co-announcement + embargo handling; Omar -> runbook + bench script. Quick run command to standardize runs:
```\n./run_bench --model mpt-7b-quant-v3 --model-compare llama2-13B-q4a \
  --sequence 2048 \
  --batch-sizes 1,8,32 \
  --sweep power,latency,throughput \
  --record-kernel traces/phaethon_dayzero\n```
Lena Ortiz: Also add perf/W regression threshold: fail if perf/W drops >5% vs baseline. Include in runbook.
Jin Park: Noted - will open a telemetry PR with schema + example payload by EOD Mon.
Evan G: I'll sync with partner comms tomorrow AM. @Lena @Jin please drop any quotes or suggested language for the announcement in the doc so legal can vet quickly.
Omar H.: Thanks all - let's aim to close outstanding PRs by Tue EOD and do a dry-run Tues 2pm PT. :thumbsup:
